name: harry-freeman-studio-deploy
description: Deploy tooling for the public site: wrangler, pinned exactly, with its own lockfile. Kept apart from the site's dependencies because wrangler brings LGPL-3.0 and CC0 packages (sharp's libvips, via miniflare) that the site's licence check (scripts/licences.mjs) does not allow; none of it is ever in dist/.
